name: Views Link Area
description: A Views area plugin to allow links as headers and footers for views.
project_description:
The Views Link Area module provides a "link" plugin for Views. It allows customized links to be placed in the header, footer, or empty text of any view. 

 The obvious use case is to create a list of all nodes of type "foo" and then add a header link to the node/add/foo page. By making it a real link rather than just a blob of HTML in a header text area, it gets all the special handling and clean URL friendliness and base-path portability that any Drupal link gets.
